_comment: IO setting rules that Radiant's map DRC enforces on LFCPNX pads, so a tool can apply them before writing a bitstream. Each rule: when = the pad usage and IO types it applies to (verified = where it was observed; it may hold more widely), forbid = attribute -> the values not allowed (the pad must use one of allowed), and evidence = Radiant's message. A pad has no input path when nothing uses its input buffer (an output, or an output with tristate, whose PADDI drives no logic). Radiant 2026.1, LFCPNX-100.

when.pad_usage: output or output+tristate, no input path
when.verified: bank 3 (HP bank), LVSTL_I pads with ODDRX4DQ + TSHX4DQ gearing

rules.evidence: map ERROR 71003016: the port has an invalid combination of IO settings according to the device specifications; suggested legalization: change TERMINATION to OFF. The same pad with an input path (DELAYA + IDDRX4DQ on its input) is accepted with TERMINATION=60.

when.pad_usage: output or output+tristate, no input path
when.verified: bank 3 (HP bank), LVSTL_I pads with ODDRX4DQS + TSHX4DQS gearing and TERMINATION=OFF

rules.evidence: map ERROR 71003018: the port cannot be placed in bank [3] based on its IO settings. Without VREF the same pad is accepted; a pad with an input path is accepted with VREF=VREF_INT.
